description:
Published cutover: one real epic through in-process minions with default ticket review, tmux gone, docs/tests match.

## Background

Phase B may delete worker tools and rewrite `/bw run` in development, but we do not publish a beadwork release that removes tmux before this phase's epic fixture passes, and we do not keep tmux as fallback after it.

## Why it is a separate phase

Core runtime + goal adapter + messaging can exist while still proving the user-visible loop: ready ticket → orchestrate implementation → settle (prose OK) → parent does not close → independent review child → parent dispositions fix|file|reject → close ticket → next ready work → epic close exits goal mode and forgets the group.

## Out of scope

Multi-epic goals, dependency-set review manifests, validation task type, beadwork-owned lint runner.

## Success

One epic with parallel and dependent tickets completes without tmux. Manual TUI smoke: parent interactive, one packet after several idle settlements, `/bw run` rejects `--workers`. lint/test/typecheck/build pass.

comments.text: Do not publish tmux-free beadwork until epic e2e passes. Script parent turns; do not call paid LLMs in CI.

title: [EPIC] One-epic published cutover
